summary: Endless 3D seagull run over the Istanbul strait, v2 with a chick to raise across runs, pier snacks and a late-game ramp, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · İstanbul Boğazı üstünde sonsuz 3D martı uçuşu, v2'de koşudan koşuya büyüyen yavru, iskele atıştırmalıkları ve oyun sonu hızlanması, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Endless run that speeds up after the first 30 seconds; stamina refilled only by simit and fish, three feathers per run
v2: carry simit to rooftop nests to feed a chick that grows across runs, from egg to a young gull that flies beside you
v2: pier snacks, a late-game ramp, a near-miss counter, halos on pickups, fact cards and the kitten on the game-over card
Bridge decks and cables, ships, kites, storm clouds and a rival gull flock; tailwind, golden simit and shield feather power-ups
Afternoon to sunset to a night of fireworks past mosques, the Galata tower and the Maiden's tower; ?auto runs with 0 errors at 60 fps
